data: Film Telo, ki je nastajal 20 let, je občutljivo in intimno raziskovanje izjemnega življenja in zapletenega notranjega sveta ženske, ki se s svojim neuklonljivim duhom bori proti redkim avtoimunskim boleznim. Film združuje intimne pogovore, osebne arhive in impresionistične podobe, ki nas popeljejo v skrivnosti človeškega telesa ter moči umetnosti in prijateljstva, kot ključ za razumevanje njegovega bistva. (Because of a violent summer storm, a traveling horse circus show arrives at Gut Kaltenbach. Ari is magically drawn to the world of horse riding, but she also sees the downsides because circus life is difficult for the horses. That's why she wants to help the old show horse Hurricane with the circus boy Carlo and with Whisper's help. When the fanatical ringmaster reveals their plan, Whisper is in danger. Then Mika finally returns from Canada.)
